    A chain of edges positioned at a node group from a fan-out, EdgesBuilder.from(Node, Node, Node...), or EdgesBuilder.from(Collection), which EdgesBuilder.NodeGroupChain.joinTo(JoinNode) connects to a JoinNode.

    A set of routes that select a single edge, which fires once when its source emits any of them; separate edges to the same target would fire once each.
